verdict: Paid Instagram is profitable this period, but checkout drop-off and weak organic engagement are capping growth.
diagnosis: Ad spend of $4,709 drove $23,762 in purchases, but only 188 of 516 add-to-carts reached checkout — a 64% cart abandonment gap.

signals.headline: Return on ad spend hit 37x
signals.detail: Every $1 in Instagram spend returned roughly $5 in tracked purchase value this period. Strong efficiency for a lamb-focused single-product ad.

signals.headline: 516 add-to-carts, only 188 checkouts
signals.detail: Roughly 6 in 10 shoppers who added to cart never started checkout. Biggest revenue leak in the funnel right now.

signals.headline: Cost per purchase around $53
signals.detail: Latest period cost per purchase is workable for premium meat, but well above the $23 cost per lead you're paying.

signals.headline: 272 reviews, latest rating 5 stars
signals.detail: Review volume and quality are a real asset. Barely surfaced in current ad creative or landing pages.

signals.headline: Followers grew by 201 this period
signals.detail: Organic Instagram is nearly flat at 13,351 followers. Story reach of 68 signals almost no content distribution outside paid.

recommendations.title: Fix the cart-to-checkout drop-off
recommendations.detail: Consider testing free shipping thresholds, guest checkout, and clearer delivery dates on the cart page. Recovering half the 328 lost carts could add meaningful revenue at no ad cost.

recommendations.title: Test a holiday roast or bundle ad
recommendations.detail: The Lamb Escalopes ad is working solo. Worth testing a second creative around holiday roasts or a starter bundle to widen the funnel before November demand.

recommendations.title: Put your 272 reviews to work
recommendations.detail: Consider adding star ratings and quotes to product pages and ad creative. Reviews are your strongest trust signal against Wildfork and other subscription competitors.
